mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment(post_id, user_id, content, parent_id, like_count) VALUES(#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{parentId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT pc.*, u.name AS user_name, u.number AS user_number, u.email AS user_email, u.age AS user_age, u.sex AS user_sex, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM post_comment pc LEFT JOIN user u ON pc.user_id = u.id WHERE pc.id = #{id}

SELECT pc.*, u.name AS user_name, u.number AS user_number, u.email AS user_email, u.age AS user_age, u.sex AS user_sex, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM post_comment pc LEFT JOIN user u ON pc.user_id = u.id WHERE pc.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY pc.create_time DESC

SELECT pc.*, u.name AS user_name, u.number AS user_number, u.email AS user_email, u.age AS user_age, u.sex AS user_sex, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM post_comment pc LEFT JOIN user u ON pc.user_id = u.id WHERE pc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pc.create_time DESC

SELECT pc.*, u.name AS user_name, u.number AS user_number, u.email AS user_email, u.age AS user_age, u.sex AS user_sex, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM post_comment pc LEFT JOIN user u ON pc.user_id = u.id WHERE pc.post_id = #{postId} AND pc.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY pc.create_time DESC

SELECT pc.*, u.name AS user_name, u.number AS user_number, u.email AS user_email, u.age AS user_age, u.sex AS user_sex, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM post_comment pc LEFT JOIN user u ON pc.user_id = u.id WHERE pc.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY pc.create_time ASC

SELECT pc.*, u.name AS user_name, u.number AS user_number, u.email AS user_email, u.age AS user_age, u.sex AS user_sex, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM post_comment pc LEFT JOIN user u ON pc.user_id = u.id ORDER BY pc.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment WHERE post_id = #{postId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE post_comment SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post_comment SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND like_count > 0
